description: Log morning resting heart rate to track your 7-day average, trend, and fitness interpretation.

faqs.a: Measure right after waking, before getting up: count beats for 60 seconds or use a wearable's morning reading.
faqs.q: How do I measure resting heart rate?

faqs.a: The tool compares your last 3 readings against the previous ones to show rising, falling, or stable trends.
Roughly: under 60 athletic, 60–70 good, 70–80 average, 80–100 below average, over 100 high. Individual variation is normal.
faqs.q: What is a good resting heart rate?

faqs.a: A lower resting heart rate generally reflects better cardiovascular fitness — but see a doctor about sudden changes.
faqs.q: Why does it drop with fitness?

howto: Each morning, measure your resting heart rate before getting up.
Watch your 7-day average and trend arrow.
Read the fitness interpretation for your range.
